indicator.name: THECC Fair Value Gaps PRO
indicator.registry_note: No permanent THECC-NNNN ID assigned. THECC_INDICATOR_REGISTRY.json carries an open question under THECC-0008 (FVG Return Filter): FVGBPR sits in the same folder and may warrant its own ID. Owner decision required before publication.
indicator.role: MARKET MAP / CONTEXT — fair value gaps with volume profiling, market structure, equal highs/lows and liquidity sweeps. Issues no trade signals.
indicator.compile_status: Not green-checked at time of writing

components.name: Fair value gap zones
components.detection: 3-bar gap; middle bar must close through the gap edge; size test gap x sensitivity > ATR, or volume filter; bar-to-bar jump <= ATR unless Allow Gaps is on

components.name: Volume split and balance percentage
components.detection: 3-bar volume split between zone halves; percentage = smaller / larger x 100

components.name: Market structure (MSS / BOS)
components.detection: Pivot zig-zag, pivot length 5 default, right bars 1; MSS = close beyond most recent opposing swing; BOS = close beyond most recent swing in the established direction

components.name: Equal highs / equal lows
components.detection: Two consecutive confirmed pivots within tolerance percent; confirmed eqLen bars after the second pivot

components.name: Liquidity sweeps
components.repaints: Label evaluated on the live bar; only a closed bar is evidence
components.detection: High > highest(high[1], lookback) and close < that high and close < open; mirrored for sell-side

terminology_lock.confirmed: The candle has closed and the result is locked
terminology_lock.repaint: A drawing or signal that changes after it first appeared
terminology_lock.sensitivity: A permissiveness multiplier: gap x sensitivity > ATR. Extreme 6.0 admits most zones, Low 1.0 fewest
